description: Source code for setting up and interacting with a MockServer instance, including starting the server, creating expectations, verifying requests, retrieving recorded requests and logs, clearing expectations, and resetting the server.

methods.name: runMockServer
methods.description: Starts the mock server with specified configuration including port, JVM options, version, and verbosity.

methods.name: createExpectation
methods.description: Creates a mock response expectation for a GET request to /view/cart with specific query parameters and cookies.

methods.name: createExpectationOverTLS
methods.description: Creates a similar expectation as createExpectation but over TLS (HTTPS).

methods.name: verifyRequestsExact
methods.description: Verifies that a request with path '/some/path' was received exactly 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtLeastTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with path '/some/path' was received at least 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtMostTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with path '/some/path' was received at most 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with path '/some/path' was received exactly 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtLeastTwiceByOpenAPI
methods.description: Verifies requests matching an OpenAPI spec URL were received at least 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyOnceByOpenAPIWithOperation
methods.description: Verifies a specific OpenAPI operation was called exactly once.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyOnceByExpectationIds
methods.description: Verifies a request with a specific expectation ID was received exactly once.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequence
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests with specified paths occurred in order.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequenceUsingOpenAPI
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests including OpenAPI spec and operation IDs occurred in order.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequenceUsingExpectationIds
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests with specific expectation IDs occurred in order.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedRequests
methods.description: Retrieves recorded requests matching specified properties.

methods.name: retrieveLoggedMessages
methods.description: Retrieves log messages from the mock server.

methods.name: clearWithRequestPropertiesMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations matching specific request properties.

methods.name: clearWithOpenAPIRequestMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations matching an OpenAPI spec and operation ID.

methods.name: clearWithExpectationId
methods.description: Clears expectations by a specific expectation ID.

methods.name: clearRequestsAndLogsWithRequestPropertiesMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations and logs matching request properties.

methods.name: clearRequestAndLogsWithOpenAPIRequestMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations and logs matching an OpenAPI spec and operation ID.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all mock server state.
